Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a property tax exemption for firsttime home buyers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a property tax exemption for firsttime home buyers; adding a new section to chapter 84.36 RCW; adding anew section to chapter 84.55 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A residence purchased by a firsttime home buyer is exempt fromproperty taxes levied for any state purpose. (2) For purposes of this section, the following definitions apply: (a) "Firsttime home buyer" means an individual who has not owneda residence within three years of the purchase. (b) "Residence" has the same meaning as in RCW 84.36.383. (3) The exemption provided for in this section may not affect thetransfer of the state property tax levy into the student achievementfund in RCW 84.52.068.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The levy for the state in any year must be reduced as necessary to p. 1 HB 2090prevent exemptions under section 1 of this act from resulting in ahigher tax rate than would have occurred in the absence of theexemptions under section 1 of this act.
The exemption in section 1 of this actapplies only to taxes levied for collection in 2010 and 2011.
